band_rule: flag when the endpoint's statistic exceeds high; high is the 95th percentile of the statistic over five honest serving variants of the same weights (default kernels, max 8 sequences, prefix cache off, CUDA graphs off, fp16), 20 repeats each

bands.metric: mean JSD vs this run, 5 answers per cell
mean JSD vs this run, 20 answers per cell
mean JSD vs this run, 50 answers per cell

determinism_note: det battery: 32 greedy prompts, 64 tokens, alone vs all at once; 32/32 identical with batch-invariant kernels (20/32 with default kernels)
prompt_set: development set, public in reference/gpu/prompts; production prompts are sealed
test: T1 one-word answers, mean JSD (bits) over 40 cells, Bruckner arXiv 2607.10252
